title: Modified Silica Kit-based Protocol for Simultaneous DNA Extraction from Various Sources
author: Wera M Schmerer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.21203/rs.3.pex-1696/v1
materials: The protocol here is a modified version of the manufacturer instruction for the E.Z.N.A.® Blood DNA Mini Kit using the "Buccal Swabs Protocol" (Omega Bio-Tek 2019); without addition of PBS to sample material (which is already in liquid form), an extended Proteinase K incubation (30min instead of 10min), elution in 100μl PCR grade water (UltraPure™, Invitrogen) heated to 65°C instead of Elution Buffer, and with re-application of the eluate to the silica column for the second elution step, instead of using a second volume of water.

For the extraction, the complete pre-digest from procedure part II is used. In case of saliva, 100μl of a homogenized sample are placed in a 2ml tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted). An extraction blank is established with 100μl ultrapure water (UltraPure™, Invitrogen).

To elute the DNA from the silica matrix, 100μl ultrapure water (UltraPure™, Invitrogen), pre-heated to 65°C, are added to the column, and incubated for 5min at RT, followed by centrifugation at 10,000 x g for 1min

The protocol here is a modified version of the manufacturer instruction for the E.Z.N.A.® Blood DNA Mini Kit using the "Buccal Swabs Protocol" (Omega Bio-Tek 2019); without addition of PBS to sample material (which is already in liquid form), an extended Proteinase K incubation (30min instead of 10min), elution in 100μl PCR grade water (UltraPure™, Invitrogen) heated to 65°C instead of Elution Buffer, and with re-application of the eluate to the silica column for the second elution step, instead of using a second volume of water.

steps.title: Prepare Hair Samples
steps.instruction: Collect and decontaminate hair strands based on hair type.

substeps.instruction: Collect 1-3 strands for coarse hair or up to 5 strands for fine/short hair.
Place sample in a 2ml reaction tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted).
Wash with 1ml PCR-grade water (UltraPure™, Invitrogen).
Wash with 500 μl absolute Ethanol.
Air-dry the tube overhead at an angle for at least 30min until Ethanol is evaporated.
Remove 5-10 barbs (vane, after-feather, or down-barbs) from the rachis using forceps (Uspeck) or microscopy scissors (Bochem).
Place sample in a 2ml reaction tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted).
Wash with 1ml PCR-grade water (UltraPure™, Invitrogen).
Wash with 500 μl absolute Ethanol.
Air-dry the tube overhead at an angle for at least 30min until Ethanol is evaporated.

steps.title: Prepare Insect Samples
steps.instruction: Collect and decontaminate insect appendages to avoid food-source DNA.

substeps.instruction: Remove 1-2 wings and 1-3 legs (depending on insect size) using forceps (Uspeck).
Place sample in a 2ml reaction tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted).
Wash with 1ml PCR-grade water (UltraPure™, Invitrogen).
Wash with 500 μl absolute Ethanol.
Air-dry the tube overhead at an angle for at least 30min until Ethanol is evaporated.

steps.title: Pre-digest Hair Samples
steps.instruction: Perform proteinase K digestion on decontaminated hair.

substeps.instruction: Cut hair into 0.5-1cm sections using decontaminated microscopy scissors (Bochem) directly into a 2ml reaction tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted).
Mix cuttings with 250ul PBS (1x) and 20ul proteinase K (10mg/ml).
Seal the tube lid with a thin strip of Parafilm (Bemis Corp.).

steps.title: Pre-digest Feather Samples
steps.instruction: Perform proteinase K digestion on decontaminated feather barbs.

substeps.instruction: Separate interlocked vane barbs using forceps (Uspeck) and place into a 2ml reaction tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted).
Mix barbs with 250ul PBS (1x) and 20ul proteinase K (10mg/ml).
Seal the tube lid with a thin strip of Parafilm (Bemis Corp.).

steps.title: Pre-digest Insect Samples
steps.instruction: Perform proteinase K digestion and homogenization of insect parts.

substeps.instruction: Place insect parts into a new 2ml reaction tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted).
Mix with 250ul PBS (1x) and 20ul proteinase K (10mg/ml).
Homogenize parts using a 1000ul pipet tip (Sarstedt) as a pestle against the tube wall.
Seal the tube lid with a thin strip of Parafilm (Bemis Corp.).

steps.title: Pre-digest Muscle Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Perform proteinase K digestion on raw or processed meat.

substeps.instruction: Place 0.1g of tissue in a 2ml reaction tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted).
Mix with 250ul PBS (1x) and 20ul proteinase K (10mg/ml).
Macerate tissue using a 1000ul pipet tip (Sarstedt) as a pestle against the tube wall.
Seal the tube lid with a thin strip of Parafilm (Bemis Corp.).
Pipette 100ul of homogenized (mixed) saliva into a 2ml reaction tube (SafeSeal, Sarsted) at the start of the silica column extraction.

steps.title: Initiate Silica Kit Extraction
steps.instruction: Prepare the sample for column purification.

substeps.instruction: Add 25μl Proteinase K Solution (kit component) and 500μl BL Buffer (kit component) to the sample and mix thoroughly.
Terminate the proteinase K digest by adding 100μl of absolute Ethanol and mixing thoroughly.
Briefly centrifuge the sample to remove liquid from the tube lid.

steps.title: Purify DNA via Silica Column
steps.instruction: Extract and wash DNA using the HiBind® DNA Mini Column.

substeps.instruction: Place a HiBind® DNA Mini Column in a 2ml collection tube.
Transfer 750μl of the sample to the column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1min and discard the filtrate.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation steps until the entire sample has been transferred.
Place the column into a new collection tube.
Add 500μl HBC Buffer (kit component), centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1min, and discard the filtrate.
Add 700μl DNA Wash Buffer (kit component), centrifuge at 10,000 x g for 1min, and discard the filtrate.
Repeat the wash step with a second aliquot of 700μl DNA Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Dry Column and Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol and recover the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Dry the column matrix by centrifuging at maximum speed (at least 10,000 x g) for 2min.
Transfer the column to a 2ml (SafeSeal, Sarsted) tube.
Perform the elution step (as per kit instructions).
Repeat the elution by re-applying the eluate to the column, followed by incubation and centrifugation to recover remaining bound DNA.

steps.title: Store DNA Extracts
steps.instruction: Store the purified DNA to prevent degradation.

substeps.instruction: Store extracts at 4°C for short-term use to avoid freeze-thaw cycles.
Store extracts at -20°C for long-term storage.
